description.value:
Kel Dor are an orange-skinned humanoid species from the low-visibility, high-pressure world of Dorin, whose atmosphere is toxic to most other species and whose light Kel Dor eyes cannot tolerate unfiltered. Off-world, Kel Dor wear distinctive antiox breath masks and dark goggles to survive in standard atmospheres, and are known for their calm patience and unusually acute extrasensory perception.

Many Kel Dor gravitate toward contemplative or Force-sensitive traditions, their species showing a notably high incidence of Force sensitivity.

traits.name: Antiox Breath Mask
traits.description: You must wear a breath mask to safely breathe standard atmospheres; without one, you suffer the effects of being in a poisonous atmosphere at the GM's discretion. While wearing your mask, you suffer no ill effects from airborne toxins or gases that rely on inhalation.

traits.name: Danger Sense
traits.description: Kel Dor possess an unusually acute extrasensory perception of danger. You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that you can see, such as traps and spells.

traits.name: Force Attuned
traits.description: You have advantage on any Wisdom (Insight) check made to sense the presence or intentions of a Force-sensitive creature.
